'''Camrin''' is a merchant from [[Altara]] who sells lacquerware. He is lean and bald except for a fringe of dark hair.
==Activities==
He dices and drinks with [[Kostelle]], [[Vane]], and Mistress [[Alstaing]] in [[The White Ring]] in [[Maderin]] until Mat joins them.
